title: Ginger-soy ling with sticky rice and vegetables
blurb: Pan-fried ling backs glazed with ginger and soy, served with fluffy rice and tender carrot and aubergine.
steps: Rinse the rice in cold water until the water runs clear, then cook according to packet instructions.
Peel and grate the ginger and garlic, then mix with the soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Peel the carrot and cut into thin batons, then cut the aubergine into bite-sized cubes.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the carrot and aubergine for 8 to 10 minutes until softened and golden, then set aside.
Pat the ling backs dry with kitchen paper and season with a pinch of salt.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the same pan and cook the fish skin-side down for 3 to 4 minutes, then flip and cook for another 2 minutes.
Pour the ginger-soy mixture over the fish and let it bubble for a minute, spooning the sauce over the fillets.
Finely chop the chives and serve the fish on the rice with the vegetables alongside, spooning over any remaining sauce and scattering with chives.
